text.p: Spelling Entertainment Group Wednesday said it named Peter Bachmann president.

In a statement, Spelling said Bachmann will oversee the day-to-day operations of Spelling Entertainment, and will be responsible for helping to shape and implement the company's strategic plan, including identifying strategic alliances and new business opportunities.
Spelling Entertainment comprises Spelling Television, Big Ticket Television, Worldvision Enterprises, Spelling Films, Republic Entertainment, Virgin Interactive Entertainment, and Hamilton Projects.
Bachmann, who joined Spelling Entertainment in 1993, has been executive vice president since October 1994.
Spelling Entertainment Group is majority owned by Viacom Inc. Further details were not immediately available.
